scope: Tiny accepted library exercises the comparison pipeline with a genuine compiler. This is NOT a full-source observation. Checked B1 classifies TypeScript root metadata; tiny emitted H has no j_library_roots export, so that full-compiler-only check is not performed.
cachePolicy: Separate API-specific validated Base caches, primed in fresh processes outside measured samples; their decoded graphs must be identical. TypeScript loads/checks Base in every fresh process. OS caches are not flushed.
timingBoundary: Request excludes imports, provenance hashing, emitted-file writes and result serialization; includes ordinary source/cache reads and compiler pipeline. Process wall includes fresh Node startup, imports, provenance and output capture. Nested API phase timings overlap and must not be summed. Output syntax/root/execution oracles run separately outside the measured process.
proofPolicy: This is a compilation comparison, not a fixed-point proof. Run the unchanged conformance/selfhost.mjs separately from the genuine checked B1; measurement rows are never synthesized into its resume report.

classifier.scope: Export-only adapter of the unchanged checked worker; this is not a new checked compiler.

result.scope: Loader/specializer/root selection only; full authoritative checking and ownership occur in every later measured request.

rootPolicy.origin: Actual checked B1 loader/specializer/j_roots preflight, untimed and not a replacement for full checking. TypeScript independently verifies eligible membership and receives this same ordered list; every timed Bend request must reproduce it.

summary.limits: Two opposite-order samples per variant, one host. TypeScript includes fresh Base checking while Bend uses separately validated on-disk Base caches; ratios do not isolate backend lowering or identical cache work.
